sentences.text: Clause 9.3 is not compliant with the applicable RBI pre-payment rule for this loan because the rule finding for this case says a pre-payment charge is not permitted for an individual, non-business, floating-rate term loan sanctioned on 10 February 2026.
The agreement nevertheless states that a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding is payable on foreclosure or pre-payment.

The earlier RBI directions on foreclosure or pre-payment charges on floating-rate term loans are no longer in force, and the 2025 pre-payment directions were also withdrawn with effect from 2025-11-28.
No other cited RBI rule in the record authorizes a pre-payment charge for this case, while the UCB conduct directions instead say such a charge is not permitted here.
